ops.title: The codex (gpt-5.6) account is out of usage credits until 2026-07-24 08:28 — sol lanes must route to Claude models until then
ops.body: On 2026-07-18 the OpenAI Codex account behind `codex-ask` / the codex plugin hit its usage limit: every call fails with "You've hit your usage limit… try again at Jul 24th, 2026 8:28 AM." Until 2026-07-24 08:28, lanes the Models table routes to gpt-5.6-sol (finder/refuter reviews, security audits, bounded implementation) must route to opus xhigh (or fable for sensitive work) instead, with fable doing the verification to keep the tier rule. Delete this memory after 2026-07-24 once codex is confirmed working again.
